activity_summary: In the morning you looked at the children's hose, as the list had said, and nothing was bought. Susanna's were whole at the heel. Judith's were not. Hamnet's had a thin place at the knee. You did not make the looking into a walk, or into a house.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and bought nothing, and named no house.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Closed the looking as obedience to the list.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the morning to a bench, and the fair to its own date.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Reported the three pairs, and spent nothing in the reporting.

facets.activity: Looked at the hose and put them back

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: Today is only hose on a bench

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I looked. I did not buy
